summary: Ported mkroom.c:mkswamp and nexttodoor, wired the SWAMP level-generation and wizard SHOPTYPE='}' dispatches, and replaced fountain.js private door-adjacency logic with the canonical helper. The admitted v46 replay now advances through swamp generation and stops at the separate hack.c:check_special_room SWAMP-entry boundary.

source.branch: At depth 16, makelevel selects SWAMP and do_mkroom calls mkswamp; mkswamp tries up to five room indices, skips non-ordinary rooms and rooms containing stairs, then marks an eligible room SWAMP and mutates eligible room cells. Its door-adjacency predicate is consumed by both this path and fountain.c:gush.

evidence: The saved v46 queue entry at challenges/evaluations/v46-baseline-29c284d97.json records segment 0, zero-based step 18, newline input, and first C RNG divergence rn2(5)=1 at mkroom.c:mkswamp:559. At the selected baseline commit, JavaScript do_mkroom(SWAMP) only recorded note_unported and consumed no swamp room-selection draw.

Upstream mkroom.c:mkswamp at lines 530-574 selects up to five rooms with rn2(svn.nroom), skips invalid/non-OROOM/stair rooms, sets SWAMP, then scans x-major/y-minor over matching room-number cells. It skips objects, monsters, traps, and cells adjacent to a door; odd cells remove engravings and become pools before eel placement draws, while even cells have a one-in-four fungus placement attempt; each selected room sets has_swamp.

Upstream mkroom.c:nexttodoor at lines 623-637 checks the 3-by-3 neighborhood in dx-major/dy-minor order, clips through isok, and returns true on a door or secret door. mkroom.c:mkswamp consumes this result; fountain.c:gush at lines 139-142 also consumes it, while js/fountain.js currently carries a private duplicate.

At the selected baseline commit, JavaScript mkshop wizard SHOPTYPE='}' and do_mkroom SWAMP both recorded note_unported('mkroom.c mkswamp'), and fountain.js carried a private nexttodoor copy. This task replaces those gaps with the canonical mkswamp/nexttodoor path and a shared fountain import.

The independent recipe recipes/mkroom.c/mkswamp-depth16-arrival-outside-seed46101145.session.json uses a different seed and character name. Its fresh C-versus-JavaScript replay matched all 5,306 RNG calls, 28 screens, and 28 cursors while executing mklev.c:makelevel -> mkroom.c:do_mkroom(SWAMP) -> mkroom.c:mkswamp.

The same recording executes mkroom.c:nexttodoor from mkswamp. The helper is pure: it scans the clipped 3-by-3 neighborhood for doors and secret doors without RNG, output, or mutation; scripts/mkroom-shop.test.mjs pins its return values and scripts/fountain.test.mjs covers the fountain caller.

A fresh replay of the selected admitted case now matches through swamp generation. Its first absent JavaScript screen and cursor are at segment 1, zero-based step 19, after the hero enters a SWAMP room. C has one further rn2(19)=10 call at segment 1, step 28, from exercise(attrib.c:509); JavaScript stops at the check_special_room SWAMP-entry boundary before that later operation.

The optional wizard SHOPTYPE='}' route is compiled and source-traced at mklev.c:1347-1348 and mkroom.c:102-143. It is not a session-addressable entrypoint: record-session.mjs:374-380 accepts v5 segments, recordSegment at 448-476 never applies per-segment environment fields, and output preservation at 758-762 does not make an unknown field active. record-session inherits ambient process.env, so an out-of-band SHOPTYPE can affect a manual run but cannot be bound to this case for later replay. The JS branch remains source-pinned by scripts/mkroom-shop.test.mjs:580-605; the depth-selected SWAMP caller and nexttodoor remain covered by the independent matching recording.

entryPointReview: The recorder-backed impure entry point is depth-selected SWAMP generation: mklev.c:makelevel -> mkroom.c:do_mkroom(SWAMP) -> mkswamp, exercised by the independent matching recording; that same path exercises nexttodoor. The optional wizard SHOPTYPE override is source-traced but is not a replayable per-session entry point. Upstream mklev.c:1347-1348 selects do_mkroom(SHOPBASE) only when wizard and nh_getenv("SHOPTYPE") are true; mkroom.c:mkshop at 102-143 reads SHOPTYPE and dispatches '}' to mkswamp. This C branch is compiled, but v5 sessions cannot bind the environment to one case: scripts/record-session.mjs:374-380 only validates version and segments, and recordSegment at 448-476 reads seg.nethackrc while constructing the child environment from process.env and fixed recorder values; it never reads a per-segment env field. Its output code at 758-762 preserves unknown segment fields without applying them. Thus ambient SHOPTYPE can affect an ad hoc recording invocation, but no serialized per-case value survives to replay, so that external environment variant is excluded from the active recorded entryPoints list. The JS branch remains source-pinned by scripts/mkroom-shop.test.mjs:580-605, which verifies the wizard SHOPTYPE='}' dispatch, mkswamp call and immediate return. fountain.c:gush is the second caller of pure nexttodoor; scripts/fountain.test.mjs exercises the shared helper through dogushforth. The admitted v46 replay reaches a separate, out-of-scope hack.c:check_special_room SWAMP-entry boundary after level generation.
